event.title: Xenia Voigt Viking Quest Fall Festival
event.venue: Xenia Voigt Arts Integration Academy, 1201 Cushing Drive, Round Rock, TX 78664

confirmed.title: Board-approved vendor lineup
confirmed.detail: K&K BBQ (savory), Hearth & Honey (sweet), Pour The Fun, and The Gelato Lab. The PTA board waived the 10% vendor fee. Participation approval only; no vendor contracts or agreements will be sent.

confirmed.title: Trackless train pledge
confirmed.detail: AiRCO Mechanical pledged $1,095 to cover the train.

confirmed.title: Candy
confirmed.detail: A+ Federal Credit Union committed 12 extra-large 5.75 lb candy bags; pickup/drop-off and recognition details are being coordinated.

confirmed.title: Cleanup and safety supplies
confirmed.detail: Express Commercial Cleaning committed a mop bucket with wringer; 2 mop handles and 2 mop heads; broom and dustpan; 1 gallon PHQ7 disinfectant with 4 labeled sprayers; 1 case 38×58 liners; half case 30×37 liners; 20 rolls kitchen paper towels; 1 gallon floor cleaner; 2 boxes medium gloves; 1 box large gloves; and ½ gallon hand sanitizer with pump.

confirmed.title: School activity equipment
confirmed.detail: Coach Pettit identified available PE equipment, including cones/markers, poly spots, bean bags, balls, hoops, jump ropes, pool noodles, buckets, ropes, sacks, balance/obstacle equipment, hippity hops, and plastic pools. Final station pull list is pending.

confirmed.title: Activities
confirmed.detail: Five planned stations: Pumpkin Bowling; Apple Scoop Challenge (80 apples covered by Brittani; no mouth-contact bobbing); Fall Sensory Mystery; Collaborative Autumn Mural; and Gratitude Tree.

confirmed.title: Garage Band
confirmed.detail: Voigt Garage Band confirmed one song, up to 5 minutes, on the cafeteria stage. A 6:00–6:30 PM window is under consideration; final timing and room setup are pending.

confirmed.title: Community donations
confirmed.detail: Austin Aquarium membership (up to 5); Austin Zoo (4 tickets); Round Rock Pumpkin Festival family pass (6); Monster Mini Golf family 4-pack; Toybrary Austin $60 punch card; Cookies & Crumbles $65 certificate; Nothing Bundt Cakes 15 individually packaged single Bundtlet towers; Paige’s Bakehouse one dozen decorated cookies for Cake Walk.

confirmed.title: Community partner
confirmed.detail: PHP Agency booth with family education and an optional, consent-based raffle. Round Rock Sweethearts offered student volunteers; headcount and assignments are pending.

confirmed.title: School website PTA link
confirmed.detail: Megan Aguirre confirmed the school website’s PTA links have been updated to point to the existing public PTA domain xeniavoigtpta.org.

pending.title: Campus approvals and safety layout
pending.detail: School approval is needed for vendor and activity locations, emergency clearances, traffic flow, ADA routes, room/field use, and campus access. Visitor parking is on School Days street; general campus parking is unavailable.

pending.title: Vendor operations
pending.detail: Confirm exact outlet locations/load, power access, arrival window, check-in, unloading route, and placements for the four approved vendors. School power is available in principle; exact specifications are not confirmed.

pending.title: Activity supplies
pending.detail: Purchase or source food-safe tubs and child-safe scoops/tongs for the Apple Scoop Challenge; finalize the supply pull list and activity layout.

pending.title: Volunteer coverage
pending.detail: Dana Berwick’s new website signup needs review and assignment. Round Rock Sweethearts’ student count and arrival/check-in details are pending.

pending.title: Donation logistics
pending.detail: Coordinate pickups/drop-offs and recognition details for A+ FCU, Express Commercial Cleaning, Board & Brush’s offered $50 digital gift certificate, Cookies & Crumbles, Nothing Bundt Cakes, and PIE Foundation materials. PIE Foundation materials require the Campus Request Form.

pending.title: Funding applications
pending.detail: H-E-B request up to $200 pending; SC Johnson $1,000 application pending; Texas Stars ticket donation is processing with no allocation yet.

pending.title: Signage estimate
pending.detail: FASTSIGNS estimate EST-17493 is under review. Do not approve production until the final school layout, quantities, and budget are confirmed.

pending.title: Sound operations
pending.detail: The board chose the school system for event audio. Confirm the district employee operating it, basic system capabilities, and how it can support the Garage Band.

declined.title: Unselected vendor replies
declined.detail: Ed’s Smokehouse, Sweet’er Than Sour, Captain’s Pizza, Rock N Grill, and 05 Diaz were not selected after the board finalized the lineup; unsent reply drafts are prepared.

followUp.title: Reply drafts prepared — pending review
followUp.detail: Ed’s Smokehouse; Sweet’er Than Sour; Board & Brush; A+ FCU; Brent Massey; Emily Ferguson; Infinity Sound Lab; Express Commercial Cleaning; Cookies & Crumbles; Nothing Bundt Cakes; Round Rock Sweethearts; The Train Quest; Evolve Round Rock; Captain’s Pizza; FASTSIGNS; Dana Berwick; Rock N Grill; 05 Diaz; LC Entertainment; and Hearth & Honey.

followUp.title: Vendor notices
followUp.detail: The four selected vendors were emailed the board’s approval and 10% fee waiver. No contracts or agreements will be sent.

changes: The board finalized four approved vendors and waived the 10% vendor fee.
The board chose school-operated sound; the district staff operator and system capabilities are being confirmed.
The activity plan is now five fall-themed stations.
blockers: School-approved campus layout, traffic, emergency clearances, ADA routes, and vendor locations.
Exact power outlets/load and district staff coordination for school audio.
Pickup schedules and final counts for donated items and student volunteers.

deadlines.detail: Target to lock school layout, vendor placements, safety details, and event materials; request digital donation certificates by this date.
Planned pickup date for printed donation items where the donor confirms it works.

actions: Get written campus approval for the layout, safety routes, vendor placements, and electrical plan.
Confirm a district sound-system operator and the Garage Band’s time and setup area.
Close donation pickup/check-in details and submit the PIE Foundation Campus Request Form.
Review FASTSIGNS estimate only after layout and quantities are approved.
Assign the new volunteer signup and confirm Sweethearts’ headcount.
